[LTES.5.2.1] Abstractly, an event trace is a list of events:

```
<event-trace> ::= <event>*
<event>       ::= "at" <instant> <op>
<op>          ::= "assert" <schema> <slot=value>*
                | "retract" <schema> <selector>
                | "advance" <duration>
                | "adapter-response" <corr> <response-or-error>
                | "adapter-emit" <adapter-id> <schema> <slot=value>*
<instant>     ::= <wall-time-ish string> | <Δ-from-start>
```
